summary: Kiro for Startups gives early-stage to Series A startups up to one year of Kiro Pro+ credits in three tiers (Starter ≤2 users, Growth ≤10, Scale ≤30). Applications are open April 7 – December 31, 2026. Requires an AWS Account ID with a business email matching the startup's domain; startups holding active AWS Activate credits are not eligible. Applicants must be 18 or older. Excluded residences: Argentina, Belarus, Brazil, China/GCR, Cuba, France, Germany, Iran, Italy, Mexico, North Korea, Poland, Russia, Spain, Syria, the region of Crimea, the so-called Donetsk People's Republic region (DNR), the so-called Luhansk People's Republic region (LNR), and the United Arab Emirates. Credits deposit to the AWS account on approval and expire 1 year after issuance; redeeming requires login via AWS IAM Identity Center.
claim_steps: Confirm early-stage to Series A eligibility, age 18+, and residence outside the excluded locations listed above (including France and Germany); active AWS Activate credit holders are not eligible.
Apply at aws.amazon.com/startups/credits/kiro with your AWS Account ID and business email matching your startup domain.
Choose a tier: Starter (≤2 users), Growth (≤10) or Scale (≤30).
On approval, credits are deposited to the AWS account and activate on provisioning.
Access Kiro via AWS IAM Identity Center (not Builder ID or social logins) to redeem credits.
